title: Angels
definition: Angels are created spiritual beings who serve God, worship Him, carry out His commands, and minister according to His will.
summary: Angels are created servants of God who worship Him and carry out His purposes.
christFocus: Angels serve the purposes of God that center on Christ, and they worship the Son as Lord.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Angels are real created beings. They are not divine, not to be worshiped, and not independent powers. They exist because God created them and they serve His purposes.

Scripture presents angels worshiping God, delivering messages, carrying out judgment, strengthening servants, rejoicing over God's works, and ministering according to His command.

Christ is superior to angels. Angels worship Him and serve within the kingdom He rules. A biblical view of angels leads to worship of God, not fascination with angels themselves.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often ignore angels completely or become fascinated in unhealthy ways. Angels matter because Scripture gives a balanced understanding of them under God's authority.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Worship God, not angels. Be encouraged that God's unseen servants obey Him, but keep your faith fixed on Christ, who is Lord over all creation.
